retained_superseded_first_matrix_attempt.qualification: Four valid empty/static measurements and one invalid separated-direct contact-filter coverage measurement are retained as superseded exploratory data. All final comparisons use the new uniform final-v2 diagnostic; no final-frozen exception is selected.

model_and_source_limitations: Final clearance uses copied PhysX-cooked convex meshes independently from PhysX contact reports. Older authored-mesh exploratory rows remain explicitly qualified by reference_kind.
No finger-joint-dependent or carried-object environment collision model is claimed. Intended-contact Pick/Place and carrying fail explicitly.
UNKNOWN, occlusion, rejected singleton/pair evidence and bounded cuboid omission remain observation limits. Exact source-cell boxes add no separate geometric padding or gap filling.

Final matched mapping targets are GT2Hz and RGBD2.5Hz; library default remains2Hz. Report exact count/window rates with short-window quantization. Reactive control cannot know obstacle motion newer than its last accepted original timestamp.

After timeline Stop/Play invalidates arm SDK handles, mapping recovery does not imply arm-controller readiness. Reactive rejects unavailable arm state; clean public runtime reinitialization is validated separately.

unchanged_direct_normal_motion_reference.qualification: Direct uses the unchanged validated loop/feedback and disabled obstacle product; this separate ordinary-motion run is not a static-obstacle avoidance comparison.
